_about: Adolescent events, ages 13-19. Same entry shape as childhood.json. Original content written for DCUGen.

events.text: Got into street racing with a crowd of older kids and rolled a borrowed car into a ditch.
Joined a gang, {gang}, for protection, and found out what protection cost.
Was arrested for {vandalism|joyriding|trespassing|a fight outside a party} and spent a night in juvenile holding.
Led {their} school's {debate|robotics|mock trial|chess} team to a state championship.
Fell hard for {npc}, a first love that ended badly when {npc} moved away.

person.status: Living in another city; they still exchange a careful message once a year.

events.text: Worked after school at {bar} washing dishes and listening to everything the regulars said.
Ran away from home for {two weeks|a month|most of a summer} and slept in bus stations.
Was recruited for an elite sports academy and trained six hours a day.
Was framed for stealing a teacher's laptop and expelled before the truth came out.
events.motive: Can't stand to see anyone blamed for something they didn't do.

events.text: Hacked the school's grading system to fix a friend's failing grade and never got caught.
events.secret: Committed a computer crime at sixteen that could still surface.

events.text: Volunteered at a free clinic and discovered a steady hand for stitches.
Lost a close friend, {npc}, to a {drunk-driving crash|overdose|gang shooting|reckless dare}.
events.regret: Not being there the night {npc} died.

deadPerson.who: {npc}, a high-school friend who died far too young

events.text: Started a punk band that played three shows and broke up over a girl named {first}.
Got a summer internship at {company} and accidentally saw files about a project that didn't officially exist.
events.hook: Someone at {company} has realized which intern opened that file.

events.text: Was the target of a cruel online rumor that followed {them} through graduation.
Spent a year as a foreign exchange student and came back speaking another language fluently.
Joined the Junior ROTC and discovered a love for structure and marksmanship.
Took a share of the blame when {sibling} was arrested, and the family never quite recovered.
Took a part-time job at a body shop and learned engines from a gruff old mechanic.

person.who: {npc}, the gruff body-shop owner who taught {name} engines
person.status: Retired to a fishing cabin; still sends terse postcards.

events.text: Snuck into a costumed villain's abandoned hideout on a dare and walked out with a souvenir.
events.hook: The villain wants that souvenir back.

events.text: Became {their} {parent}'s full-time caregiver during a long illness, while still in school.
Was the star of the school play and seriously considered acting for a living.
Got into a fistfight with {npc} that turned into a lifelong friendship.

person.who: {npc}, a friend made the hard way in a high-school fistfight
person.status: Still the first person {name} calls in a crisis.

events.text: Was caught up in a riot after a controversial verdict and saw both sides at their worst.
Got {their} {parent}'s permission to quit school and work full time to help the family.
Taught {themself} parkour on the rooftops of {hometown}.
Was a junior lifeguard and made a dramatic rescue that ended up on the local news.
Ran a profitable side business selling {fake IDs|test answers|bootleg concert tickets}.
Joined a street-art crew tagging trains and learned every rail yard in the city.
Testified as a witness against a local drug dealer and spent a year looking over {their} shoulder.

person.who: {npc}, a dealer who went to prison partly on {name}'s testimony
person.status: Out on parole and asking around.

events.text: Became obsessed with tracking a costumed vigilante through police-scanner chatter.
Was sent to a strict wilderness program for 'troubled teens' and came back harder.
Won a regional boxing tournament in the {lightweight|middleweight|heavyweight} division.
Discovered {they_were} adopted by finding papers in {their} {parent}'s desk.
events.secret: Has been quietly searching for {their} birth parents.

events.text: Spent a summer interning at {paper} and fell in love with chasing stories.
Had a mental-health crisis at seventeen and spent a month in a residential program.
Took the fall for a friend's crime and did six months in {prison}.

person.who: {npc}, the friend whose crime {name} took the fall for
person.status: Owes {name} a debt that hasn't been repaid.

events.text: Was a math prodigy who skipped two grades and never fit in with anyone.
Became the unpaid sitter for half the neighborhood's kids.
Got a scholarship to {college} and was the first in the family to go.
Was expelled from {school} for {fighting|cheating|a prank involving the principal's car}.
Started training at a boxing gym run by an ex-cop who asked a lot of questions.
Joined a church youth group mostly to meet someone, and found faith instead.
Lost a scholarship after a knee injury ended a promising athletic career.
events.regret: The athletic career that ended with one bad landing.

events.text: Was a camp counselor who led a group of kids out of a forest fire.
Ran small cons on tourists with a fast-talking friend named {first}.
Found out {their} {parent} was having an affair, and has never told anyone.
events.secret: Knows about a parent's affair and has kept it buried.

events.text: Saw {sibling} get hurt in a fight and went after the kid responsible with a tire iron.

complication.text: When someone hurts family, the restraint goes out the window.

events.text: Was briefly famous online for a video of {themself} stopping a mugging.
Was picked up by a talent scout and spent a year modeling in another city.
Snuck out every night for a month to watch a meteor that seemed to change direction.
Worked as a runner for a bookie and learned to do odds in {their} head.
Got lost on a camping trip for three days and came back with a story nobody believed.
events.hook: Others who got lost in those same woods tell the same story.

events.text: Organized a walkout at school over a teacher's firing and made the evening news.
Spent a summer working on a fishing boat in rough northern waters.
Fell in with an older crowd who treated cruelty as a sport.
Turned down a chance to join {gang} and paid for it with a beating.
Took a self-defense class after a scare and kept going long after the course ended.
Was diagnosed with a heart condition and told to avoid stress, which did not work out.

complication.text: A heart condition flares up under extreme strain.
